name: Deep Extraction
gate: after section inventory, before token mapping
instruction: Extract computed styles from every node in the catalog. This is the core of the skill. Incomplete extraction is the primary failure mode - if you skip a node, the output will have wrong spacing, wrong colors, or missing elements.

actions.instruction: Call get_computed_styles with batches of node IDs from the catalog. Paper supports batching - pass arrays of 8-12 node IDs per call to minimize round trips. Start from the section root and work down level by level.
actions.batch_size: 8-12 nodes per call. More is fine if they're simple nodes.
actions.coverage_rule: Every node in the catalog MUST have its styles extracted. After all batches complete, cross-check: is every catalog ID present in the extracted styles? If not, extract the missing ones.

actions.instruction: Call get_jsx on each top-level child of the section to get the HTML structure. Use format 'inline-styles' for exact values. This gives you the nesting structure and text content that get_computed_styles alone does not convey.
actions.note: get_jsx returns the rendered HTML structure. Use this as the skeleton for your {framework} component. The inline styles in JSX may differ from get_computed_styles - prefer get_computed_styles values; use JSX for structure and text content only.

actions.instruction: Record the exact text content of every Text node. get_tree_summary truncates text - use get_jsx or get_children to get full strings. Spec prose is NOT the source of truth for text content in the design. The Paper node's text IS.
actions.verify: Compare every text string against the spec. If they differ, use the Paper value (the spec was written from Paper, but may have been paraphrased or truncated).

actions.instruction: For every SVG node in the catalog, call get_jsx to get the full SVG markup. SVGs cannot be reconstructed from screenshots or descriptions. The exact path data, viewBox, stroke-width, stroke-linecap, and stroke-linejoin must come from get_jsx.
actions.alternative: If the SVG matches a known icon library (Lucide, Feather, Heroicons), record the icon name instead of raw SVG. But verify the match - do not assume.

actions.instruction: For every Rectangle or Frame node whose computed styles include backgroundImage: url(...), call get_fill_image to extract the image. Download the image to the project's static asset directory and reference it as an or CSS background-image with a local path. Common cases: logos, avatars, photos, icons with raster fills. An empty placeholder div where Paper has an image fill is a defect.
actions.when: Any node whose get_computed_styles returns a backgroundImage containing 'url('

extracted_data_format.instruction: Organize extracted data as a flat lookup keyed by node ID. Every entry has: computed styles (from E1), HTML structure (from E2), text content (from E3), SVG markup if applicable (from E4).

KO0-0.text: Two roles. Different access. Same student.

properties_to_ignore: any property not in the always_extract list that has its default value
